decisions.reason: The source changes only the explored finish and champagne-gold distribution; it does not change the geometric peak-alignment rule between the Hero V and É accent.
Selective color-distribution studies do not change the second V's geometry, construction method, right-arm reach, or relationship to the Hero V.
Applying champagne gold selectively does not alter the requirement that the É accent reuse the approved Hero V terminal geometry exactly.
The instruction that other elements remain black concerns material distribution and leaves all E and L letterform architecture, originality, and derivation constraints unchanged.
The source applies alternative material treatments to the existing Hero V right arm without changing the approved Hero V geometry.
The proposed gold placement may visually emphasize elements but does not change the second V's required geometric height or prominence relationships.
The source explores coloring the signature elements but does not change their shared terminal shape, terminal intent, or geometric evaluation rule.
Message 185 requests finish and color-distribution comparisons only and contains no change to spacing or kerning.
The material-distribution exploration does not modify the E and L cap-height relationship to the second V.
The source does not discuss or alter the common baseline alignment of the wordmark.
The requested material comparison does not change the obligation to provide design rationale with review rounds.
